nodes.name: Synthesis of Pt/cage
nodes.procedure: Initially, I-cage-Cl (15 mg) was dissolved in 9 mL water (Solution I). K2PtCl4 (1.06 mg) was dissolved in 0.5 mL water (Solution II). NaBH4 (1.00 mg) was dissolved in 0.5 mL water (Solution III). KOH (0.56 mg) was dissolved into 1 mL water (Solution IV). Solution II was added into Solution I and the mixture solution was aged for 5 min. Then, Solution III was added into the mixture with vigorously shaking for 2 min. Solution IV was finally dropped into the mixture within 2 min under shaking. After the complete addition of Solution IV, the mixed solution was kept shaking for 30 min. The as-prepared Pt/cage was obtained by centrifugation (6439 × g, 15 min), washed by milli-Q water for three times, and finally freeze-dried.
nodes.method: electrostatically induced injection and in situ reduction

nodes.name: Electrode Preparation
nodes.procedure: Pt/cage (0.5 mg), a Nafion dispersion 1-propanol (30 μL, ~5 w t.%), and graphite nanoplatelets (2 mg) were mixed in a 1 mL mixture solution of ethanol/water (v/v ~ 1:1). After sonification for 30 min, a catalyst ink was ready. Next, the Pt/cage working electrode was prepared by dropping a 40 μL portion of the ink onto the glassy carbon working electrode, which after drying ended up with a Pt loading of 5.4 μg cm−2.

nodes.name: Synthesis of SHINs
nodes.procedure: Gold chloride trihydrate (23.2 mg) was dissolved in 200 mL water. Solution was boiled, to which 1.4 ml of Solution VI (citrate) was quickly added. The mixture solution was kept boiling with flux for 1 h. After cooling, 30 ml of the Au dispersion was mixed with 0.4 mL of Solution VII (APTES) and 3.2 ml of Solution VIII (sodium silicate adjusted to pH 10 with HCl). The mixture solution was stirred at 99 °C for 30 min to get the SHINs dispersion. The SHINs dispersion was centrifugated at 402 × g for 10 min.
